gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 116.486m. During 2018 management recorded a net strengthening of prior year provisions of GBP 48.098m (a c.41.3% increase versus opening gross claims outstanding), primarily driven by adverse development on prior large natural catastrophe losses (notably the September 2017 storms and two Mexico earthquakes collectively referred to as 'HIMM') and related large loss development and reinsurance impacts. The movement is presented explicitly in the technical reserves reconciliation as 'Change in prior year provisions' and the report includes RDS scenario losses illustrating potential nat-cat exposures.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions (closing balance at 1 Jan = prior year closing) on page 16. Prior year development taken from the technical reserves reconciliation row 'Change in prior year provisions' on page 39 (explicitly stated). No explicit narrative sentence quantifying prior year development beyond the table; therefore the table row was used as the authoritative source. LOB-specific prior year movements are not provided in the report so per-LOB reserve movements are not available. Several named events are RDS scenario entries (page 25) and are included with estimated net RDS losses; these are scenario estimates rather than realized event settlements.
